audit.summary: The SE cumulative-regret conclusion of Theorem6.3 is false on its stated variance domain. An allowed fixed sequence V_T=T^2-1/2 makes its claimed rate tend to0, although a legal two-point SE instance incurs a pathwise positive first-round regret. The central variance lemma's inspected good-index/determinant argument is sound.
